verdict.rationale: Docs confirm FIDO2 security keys and passkeys are supported as authentication methods and that Conditional Access can require MFA for specific apps (docs-6,7,20,21, docs-2,19). However, independent reporting describes a documented downgrade attack that can bypass FIDO2 enforcement in Entra ID when an alternative auth method exists for recovery, undermining the guarantee that FIDO2 can be strictly 'required' with no bypass path, and users report needing external mitigations (VPN gating) to compensate. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of phishing-resistant MFA enforcement that closes this alternative-method loophole, and confirmation the downgrade vulnerability has been fully remediated.
